Scheduler Noah confirms the neurology follow-up on Friday April 11 at 11:30 AM remains booked. Scheduler Noah states the remaining scheduled items before closure of Asha Patel's workup are the MRI on Tuesday April 8 at 7:15 PM and the neurology follow-up on Friday April 11 at 11:30 AM.
